envelope.description: Add the main review-worker registry and trusted control bridge

body.title: Add the main review-worker registry and trusted control bridge
body.summary: Add proposed src/daemon/threads/review-workers.ts to own per-review routing, registered incarnations, bounded progress cache, subject/cleanup exclusions and trusted owner lifecycle bridging. Reuse current thread/status/supervisor services and review-state host authority; serialize only data, not AbortSignals, providers or live socket objects.
acceptanceChecks: Distinct valid review identities reserve distinct workers, including same-session and mixed-family submissions; no global review queue is added.
Main derives controller authority/reviewer routing from trusted host context and forwards action/execution/sequence envelopes only to the registered target.
Worker loss/late messages cannot release another incarnation's reservation or mutate its progress; replacement waits for targeted process and store/lock reclamation.
Cross-worker design-subject and story/artifact cleanup exclusions preserve current guarantees without leaving authority in worker-local module globals.
Daemon reviewer lifetime survives observer disconnect; controller-owner loss interrupts only its owned reviews under current recovery rules.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-workers.test.ts: canonical identities own one incarnation and preserve subject and cleanup exclusions
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-workers.test.ts: stale owner messages and targeted disconnects cannot mutate another review
